title: Excellentman
description:
A CLI tool for running [Newman](https://github.com/postmanlabs/newman) (Postman's CLI runner) with parameters sourced from Excel spreadsheets. Each worksheet drives a separate test run, enabling data-driven API testing at scale. Supports custom field transformations, HTML and XML report generation, and customizable report templates.

Available on [PyPI](https://pypi.org/project/excellentman/) — install with `pip install excellentman`.
